note: Skills V loads from outside its workspace (~/.agents/skills, ~/.openclaw/skills). They are third-party packs, not V's own text, so the workspace does not copy them; the installer (line A) installs the 'install' ones at pinned versions. Snapshot of V on 2026-11-27. Each 'install' entry names an exact source (npm package@version, or GitHub repo + commit + path) and the directory to install into; sources were matched against V's files by git object hash on 2026-11-27. Never copy these from V.
